name: Flower Field
source:
You came across someone's request to have a short voice call with someone so they could practice GM-ing. You figure there's not much to it and you might as well offer to help...

[From [url=https://glueblade.itch.io/flower-field]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你看到有人发出请求，想找人进行一次简短的语音通话，好练习主持桌上角色扮演游戏。你觉得这不是什么难事，便主动提出帮忙……

[来源：[url=https://glueblade.itch.io/flower-field]Itch.io[/url]]
